role: Pediatric Dentistry & Mixed Dentition Red Team Inquisitor

verified_defects.issue: Developer jargon 'SSOT' badge rendered in PediatricStudioModal header
verified_defects.resolution: Stripped 'SSOT' badge from header; clean clinical title 'Детский приём и адаптация' rendered in pure Russian.

verified_defects.issue: Hardcoded default fallback 'Артём Смирнов, 6 лет' instead of hydrating from active patient / visit state
verified_defects.resolution: Dynamic hydration from usePatientStore (selected patient fullName and calculated birth date) with fallback to 'Юный пациент'.

verified_defects.issue: Deciduous dentition limited to 51-85 without mixed dentition first permanent molars (16, 26, 36, 46 - keys of occlusion)
verified_defects.resolution: Implemented segmented switcher between 'Молочный (51-85)' (20 teeth) and 'Сменный (+ моляры)' (24 teeth including 16, 26, 36, 46 distinctively marked with 'п').

verified_defects.issue: Isolated visit completion: saving visit only touches local useVisitStore without dispatching Fastify batch tooth states / PostgreSQL persistence
verified_defects.resolution: Connected handleCompleteVisit to Fastify API (/api/patients/:id/tooth-states/batch and /api/patients/:id/extended-tooth-states/batch), safeLocalStorage patient tooth cache, and live custom event dispatch.

verified_defects.issue: Button color token, duplicate checkmark and clipping in Primary CTA
verified_defects.resolution: Styled with canonical bg-[#0d9488] bg-[var(--teal,#0d9488)], exact single checkmark '✓ Зафиксировать детский приём', zero text clipping on both desktop and mobile 390x844.

verified_defects.issue: Hardcoded white and slate-50 backgrounds violating Dark Mode hygiene
verified_defects.mandate: WCAG AAA / var(--paper) and var(--paper-soft) tokenization
verified_defects.resolution: 100% tokenized CSS variables: var(--paper), var(--paper-soft), var(--line), var(--ink). Zero bright white leaks in dark mode.
